name: @appbana/normalization-agent
description: BIM → AIM Normalization Agent. Consumes a validated BIM, invokes a structured-output AI adapter against the versioned `prompt.normalization-agent.bim-to-aim` template, validates the returned candidate against the AIM v0.1 JSON Schema, and records provenance for every call. Deterministic given the injected adapter + registry + schema.
